Convenience wrapper: build an event library from run_hazard_model() output

Source: R/hazard_downscale.R
build_event_library_from_out.Rd

Extracts one location's track-point and event tables from run_hazard_model() output and forwards them to build_event_library().

Usage

build_event_library_from_out(out, location, ..., seed = NULL)

Arguments

out

List returned by run_hazard_model().

location

Character scalar target location name.

...

Additional arguments passed to build_event_library().

seed

Optional integer seed for deterministic library construction.

Value

List in the format returned by build_event_library().

See also

build_event_library

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
lib <- build_event_library_from_out(out, location = "Saba")
lib$events
} # }
